design_overview: A clean, modern task management application designed with a focus on clarity and usability. The interface uses a card-based layout with clear visual hierarchy, making task creation, completion, and deletion intuitive. The design follows mobile-first principles with touch-friendly components, subtle shadows, and rounded corners. Primary actions are visually dominant with a vibrant blue accent, while secondary actions remain discoverable but subtle. The app features a bottom navigation pattern for easy thumb access and uses a light color scheme with high contrast for readability.

typography.font_family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

screens.name: Task List
screens.purpose: Display all active tasks and provide quick access to task creation

key_components.interaction: Static header, profile icon navigates to Profile screen

key_components.name: Task Counter
key_components.styling: Secondary text color, 14px, positioned below header with 16px padding, displays '5 tasks pending'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates dynamically based on task count

key_components.name: Empty State Message
key_components.styling: Centered text with secondary color, 16px, displays when no tasks exist: 'No tasks yet. Tap + to create your first task'

key_components.name: Task Card 1
key_components.styling: White surface with 12px rounded corners, 8px shadow, 16px padding, contains task title in bold 16px, description in 14px secondary text, and completion checkbox on left
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen, checkbox marks task complete

key_components.name: Task Card 2
key_components.styling: White surface with 12px rounded corners, 8px shadow, 16px padding, contains task title in bold 16px, description in 14px secondary text, and completion checkbox on left
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen, checkbox marks task complete

key_components.name: Task Card 3
key_components.styling: White surface with 12px rounded corners, 8px shadow, 16px padding, contains task title in bold 16px, description in 14px secondary text, and completion checkbox on left
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Task Detail screen, checkbox marks task complete

key_components.name: Create Task Button
key_components.styling: Circular floating action button, 56px diameter, primary blue background with white plus icon, positioned 24px from bottom right, subtle shadow
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens Create Task screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar

screens.user_flow: Entry point of the app. Users land here after login. From here they can tap a task card to view details, tap the + button to create a new task, or use bottom navigation to switch to Completed or Profile screens.

key_components.name: Task Title Input

key_components.name: Title Character Counter
key_components.styling: Secondary text, 12px, right-aligned below title input, shows '0/255 characters'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates as user types

key_components.name: Task Description Input
key_components.styling: White surface with light border, 12px rounded corners, 120px height, 16px padding, multiline, placeholder 'Add description (optional)' in secondary text
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens keyboard for text entry, optional field

key_components.name: Description Character Counter
key_components.styling: Secondary text, 12px, right-aligned below description input, shows '0/1000 characters'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates as user types

key_components.name: Validation Error Message
key_components.styling: Error red color, 14px, appears below title input when validation fails, displays 'Task title is required'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, only visible when user attempts to submit without title

key_components.styling: Primary blue background, white text, 48px height, full width with 16px side margins, 12px rounded corners, bold 16px text 'Create Task'

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Task List screen by tapping the + floating action button. Users enter task details and tap Create to save, or Cancel to discard. After creation, returns to Task List with new task visible at top.

screens.name: Delete Confirmation
screens.purpose: Confirm task deletion to prevent accidental removal

key_components.name: Modal Overlay
key_components.styling: Semi-transparent dark background covering entire screen, 40% opacity
key_components.interaction: Tapping overlay dismisses modal and returns to Task Detail

key_components.name: Modal Container
key_components.styling: White surface, 16px rounded corners, 24px padding, centered on screen, 320px width, subtle shadow
key_components.interaction: Contains confirmation content, prevents tap-through to overlay

key_components.interaction: Non-interactive visual indicator of destructive action

key_components.name: Modal Title
key_components.styling: Primary text, bold 20px, centered, displays 'Delete Task?'

screens.user_flow: Triggered by tapping Delete button on Task Detail screen. Modal appears over current screen. Users can confirm deletion or cancel. Confirming removes task and returns to Task List. Canceling returns to Task Detail.

responsive_design: The application follows a mobile-first approach optimized for screens 375px-428px wide. All touch targets meet the minimum 44x44px size for accessibility. Cards and lists use full width with 16px side margins. The layout adapts gracefully to larger screens by maintaining max-width constraints and centering content. Bottom navigation remains fixed and accessible on all screen sizes. Modals scale proportionally while maintaining readability. Text sizes remain consistent across devices with appropriate line heights for readability.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Form inputs include visible labels and placeholders. Error messages are clearly associated with their inputs. Focus states are visible for keyboard navigation. Screen reader labels are provided for all icons and interactive elements. Status changes are announced to assistive technologies. The app supports dynamic type sizing and respects user preferences for reduced motion.
animations: Subtle animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms ease-in-out slides. Button presses show 100ms scale feedback (0.95x). Card taps include 200ms elevation change. Modal appearances use 250ms fade-in with slight scale. Checkbox toggles animate with 200ms spring effect. Task completion shows 300ms strikethrough animation. List items animate in with 150ms staggered fade. Loading states use subtle pulse animations. All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion settings and can be disabled.
icons: Icons follow a consistent 24px size with 2px stroke weight. The icon set includes: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (ribbon), heart (outline heart), filter (funnel), plus (addition symbol), edit (pencil), trash (bin), and share (arrow). Icons use the primary color for active states and secondary color for inactive states. All icons are semantic and match their interaction purpose. No emojis are used to maintain professional appearance and cross-platform consistency.
